description: Approval payload for the ANGKOR EYES Approval Gate. A push/merge/deploy may only proceed when an approval matching this schema is approved, unexpired, and re-verified (action_hash + target_commit_sha) at execution time.

action_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of JSON [requested_action, branch_name, target_commit_sha]. Recomputed by the runner before execution; mismatch = refuse.

approved_by.description: Telegram user id of the human approver.

branch_name.description: Agent branch only, e.g. agent/dev/task12. Never 'main'.

requested_action.description: Exact action being approved: push | merge | deploy | revert.

requested_by_agent.description: Role of the agent that requested approval: lead | dev | qa | reviewer | security.

target_commit_sha.description: Full 40-char commit SHA that was reviewed. Runner re-verifies HEAD equals this SHA.

target_repo.description: Repository identifier, e.g. owner/repo or local path.

title: AngkorEyesApproval
